column4: Restores [x] Magicka when you take Flame, Frost, Shock, Magic, Earth, or Oblivion Damage equivalent to 30% of your Maximum Health. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.
Increases your Spell and Physical Resistance by 1500 when you are using a Shield or a Frost Staff.
Restore [x] Health when you deal direct Critical Damage. This can only occur once every 5 seconds.
Reduces the Stamina cost of abilities by 80% for 3 seconds after breaking free of a stun, knockdown, fear, disorient, or stagger.
